import plistlib, pathlib
base = pathlib.Path('/Users/radoniusz/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/53CBD69C-E05C-4DAC-9A2C-2504C42CB57F/data/Containers/Shared/AppGroup/58B41E47-2302-430E-B165-30206FF0042C/MXFileStore/@alice:localhost/rooms')
for state in sorted(base.glob('*/state')):
    with state.open('rb') as f:
        obj = plistlib.load(f)
    objs = obj['$objects']
    room_id = None
    room_name = None
    for entry in objs:
        if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get('eventType') == 2:
            content = objs[entry['content'].data]
            if isinstance(content, dict):
                ns = content.get('NS.objects')
                keys = content.get('NS.keys')
                if ns and keys:
                    pairs = dict(zip([objs[k.data] if hasattr(k,'data') else k for k in keys], [objs[o.data] if hasattr(o,'data') else o for o in ns]))
                    if pairs.get('name'):
                        room_name = pairs['name']
                    if pairs.get('alias'):
                        room_name = room_name or pairs['alias']
            room_id = objs[entry['roomId'].data]
    print(f'{state.parent.name}: {room_name}')
